fusions.name: Strip to the Bone
fusions.desc: A gorging bite that deals 17 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Gnawing Cloud
fusions.desc: A chewing cloud deals 3 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, with a 20% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorge on Stores
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Full
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
